title: Dungeon Cross Section
description: A detailed vertical cross-section of a multi-level fantasy dungeon reveals interconnected stone chambers, staircases, prison cells with iron bars, a central ritual room with a circular pool and altar, libraries, and hanging chains. The cutaway view shows various floors from the mossy stone entrance at the bottom to the upper halls with statues and barred windows.
